topography.project_purpose: Basis Trading. Structurally: 30 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 4 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs, 3 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 11 common project-authored base contract(s) (owned, typeandversioninterface, simplereadaccesscontroller). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
